data.summary:
Seasoned Engineering Leader with more than 15 years of experience in Software, Mobile and AI-driven application development across Banking, Telecom, Infotainment Industries.
2 years in Generative AI, specializing in AI-driven application development, Agentic AI Solutions, LLM orchestration, and cloud-native architectures.
Proven expertise in leading cross-functional teams to deliver scalable, secure, and innovative solutions.
Adept at driving digital transformation initiatives, enhancing user satisfaction, and ensuring compliance with regulatory standards.
Skilled in Agentic AI Solutions, Agentic Architecture, Technical Project management, Mobile architecture, and mentoring teams to achieve strategic objectives.

raw_sections.awards:
Achievements
Developed AI Agentic and multi agent Orchestration solutions using CREW AI, Lang Graph.
Developed RAG system using Lang Chain, FAISS. 
Increased Barclays Mobile App rating from 2.7 to 4.8, significantly improving customer engagement and satisfaction.
Boosted revenue by 35-40% of Barclays Mobile Application.  Played a key role in the organization's Mar Tech initiative.  Successfully led onsite and offsite teams for Bell Canada.  Spearheaded cloud-native application design, enhancing scalability and reliability.
raw_sections.skills:
Core Competencies
AI/ML Integration and Innovation  Generative AI & LLM Application Development  Digital Transformation Strategies  Mobile & Cloud Architecture  Stakeholder Management and Strategic Planning  Cross-Functional Team Leadership
Key Skills
Programming Languages : Python,Kotlin,Java   Agentic AI Frameworks : LangGraph,Crew AI,Agno, Google ADK  Protocols : Model Context Protocol ( MCP ), Google A2A  ML/DL Frameworks : TensorFlow,Pytorch  LLMs : LlamaIndex,OpenAI,Deepseek  Vector Databases : FAISS,Chroma DB  LLM App Orchestration : LangChain  AI Monitoring : LangFuse
IDE: : Visual Studio Code,Cursor,Android Studio
Generative AI : GANs, Transformers, RLHF  Cloud Platforms : Firebase, Google Cloud, Adobe  Functional Skills : Agile, Team leadership, Stakeholder Engagement  Project Mgt. Tools : JIRA, Confluence  Security : DexGuard, Arxan, Veracode  Version Control : Git  CI/CD Tools : Jenkins,Bit Bucket
raw_sections.experience:
Professional Experience
AI Consultant Apr 2024 -Present
RAG-Based Offer Eligibility Assistant
Tech Stack: Python, Lang Chain, FAISS, Fast API, Internal APIs
Developed a Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) system to evaluate customer eligibility for Martech offers in a financial services environment.
Fetched structured and semi-structured KYC data from internal systems via secure APIs and stored context as vector embeddings for efficient semantic search.
Used Lang Chain to generate grounded, explainable eligibility decisions based on business logic and regulatory criteria.
Achieved a 40% reduction in manual KYC evaluations and improved offer targeting

precision by 25%. Integrated the system with internal marketing workflows and dashboards for real-time usage by business teams.
Assistant Vice President - Cards Platform Barclays Bank Oct 2020 –Mar 2024
This role at Barclays showcases my leadership in digital transformation, mobile app development,
and collaboration across diverse teams to achieve strategic goals.
AI-Powered Conversional Chatbot: Developed a chatbot using NLP and machine learning that can understand and respond to user queries related to Send cash and Balance Transfer.
AI-Driven Recommendation System: Designed and implemented a recommendation system using Adobe Sensei that can suggest Various Offers to Credit Card customers based on their preferences and Customer Behaviors.
Spearheaded the development of the USCB Cards Mobile Application, contributing to the digital transformation.
Led architectural design and development, Platform Engineering Capability, enhancing scalability and user engagement
Engineered Customer Offer, KYC and Balance Transfer features, achieving a 35-40% increase in revenue.
 Enhanced scalability and user engagement, improving app ratings from 2.7 to 4.8.  Spearheaded cloud-native application design, ensuring high scalability and availability.
 Ensured strict compliance with regulatory standards by prioritizing data security
Technical Lead Tech Mahindra Sep 2016 - Jun 2020
Led Onshore & offshore development teams for telecom clients, delivering high-quality software and mobile application solutions.
MVM (My Virgin Mobile – Bell Canada): developed a self-serve Android app enabling Virgin
Mobile customers to manage accounts efficiently. Coordinated with product owners, Scrum Masters, and technical architects for deliverables. Network Fleet (Verizon LLC):
Enhanced features like MapQuest Upgrade, 64-bit support, and rebranding for Network Fleet Manager and Driver Applications.
Senior Engineer - Product Development Harman Connected Services (A SAMSUNG Company) Apr 2014 - Jun 2016
Designed connected car/infotainment applications for Automotive clients.  Built the Contacts and Call Module for infotainment systems, synchronizing data for clients like Visteon and Harman International.
Room Book Scheduler (Client - AMX): Developed an Android Application for meeting room bookings, integrating Google Calendar and Office 365.
Lead Engineer Luxos Technologies May 2012 -Mar 2014
Delivered enterprise applications for pharmaceutical industries (GSK, Mankind).  Built SMART Pitch, a sales mobile application, enhancing client engagement for pharmaceutical industries.
Senior Android Developer BookBox Inc Jan 2007 - Apr 2012
Developed multilingual Ani Books applications, featuring video stories with synchronized subtitles.
